race.title: Pegasus Handicap Chase
race.verdict: TROPICAL TALENT hasn't won for ages but recent performances in this sphere suggest that could be about to change. Sporting first-time blinkers, he gets the vote over Alba Crus , who was in the process of running well on his chasing debut back in the spring and returns having had a breathing operation. Top-weight Mary rounds off the shortlist. TROPICAL TALENT ALBA CRUS (IRE) MARY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Mary (13/8), Alba Crus (5/2), Tropical Talent (4/1), Midnight View (8/1), River Don (10/1), Boom Boom (16/1)
